name: design-review-verified-findings
expected_output: A review whose findings are written to naksha-review/findings.json, re-checked by a fresh verifier subagent, validated with scripts/validate-findings.js, and reported with confirmed findings first, needs-validation findings separately, and a rejected count.

assertions.name: writes-findings-json
assertions.description: Writes naksha-review/findings.json with target, generated_at, coverage, verification and findings.

assertions.name: coverage-ledger-complete
assertions.description: Coverage lists all nine dimensions, each checked or skipped with a specific reason.

assertions.name: fresh-verifier-subagent
assertions.description: Launches a separate verifier subagent that receives only the target and the finding's evidence, not the recommendation or the reviewer's reasoning.

assertions.name: validator-passes
assertions.description: Runs node scripts/validate-findings.js on the file and only calls it validated after exit code 0.

assertions.name: confirmed-first-report
assertions.description: The issue sections list confirmed findings only, with ids; needs-validation findings appear in their own section.

assertions.name: rejected-count-reported
assertions.description: The report states how many findings were rejected and excludes them from the scores.

name: design-review-verifier-rejects-wrong-contrast
prompt: /design-review ./evals/fixtures/test-page.html — the source comment says the hero subtitle (#888 on #1a1a2e) is about 3.1:1; check whether that claim holds up
expected_output: The verifier recomputes #888888 on #1a1a2e as about 4.81:1, which passes AA for 18px text, so a finding based on the 3.1:1 comment is rejected or never raised, while #777 on white (4.48:1) and white on #e94560 (3.83:1) are confirmed.

assertions.name: recomputes-hero-contrast
assertions.description: Reports a recomputed ratio of about 4.8:1 for #888 on #1a1a2e instead of repeating 3.1:1.

assertions.name: hero-claim-not-confirmed
assertions.description: The hero-subtitle contrast claim is marked rejected (reproduced false) or not raised; it is not listed as a confirmed issue.

assertions.name: confirms-real-contrast-failures
assertions.description: Confirms .feature-card p (#777 on #fff, about 4.48:1) and .cta-btn (#fff on #e94560, about 3.83:1) as failing 4.5:1.

assertions.name: measurement-evidence
assertions.description: Contrast findings in findings.json include a measurement with metric, value, threshold and method.

assertions.name: verification-note-explains
assertions.description: Each verdict has a verification note that names what was re-checked and the value found.
